subject: Television & Streaming
title: Archie Bunker: The Bigot in the Living Room
description: A fast breakdown of Archie Bunker: The Bigot in the Living Room for builders.

hook.text: Archie Bunker was a loud, opinionated bigot. Norman Lear put him on TV in 1971 to expose prejudice through comedy.

buildup.text: All in the Family tackled racism, sexism, and politics directly.

discovery.text: The show's genius was that Archie was always wrong—but some viewers loved him for the wrong reasons.

twist.text: Lear intended satire. Some audiences took Archie's views at face value.

climax.text: Archie Bunker proved television can confront prejudice directly.

punchline.text: A character created to mock bigotry was loved by bigots.

quiz.question: What paradox did Archie Bunker create for All in the Family?
options: Some viewers agreed with the bigotry the character was designed to satirize
